articles.title_en: Energy price shocks, monetary policy and inequality
articles.title_cn: 能源价格冲击、货币政策与不平等
articles.abstract_en: We study how monetary policy shapes the aggregate and distributional effects of an energy price shock. Based on the observed heterogeneity in consumption exposures to energy and household wealth, we build a quantitative small open-economy HANK model that matches salient features of the Euro Area data. Our model incorporates energy as both a consumption good for households with non-homothetic preferences as well as a factor input into production with input complementarities. Independently of policy energy price shocks always reduce aggregate consumption. Households with little wealth are more adversely affected through both a decline in labor income as well as negative direct price effects. Active policy responses raising rates in response to inflation amplifies aggregate outcomes through a reduction in aggregate demand, but speeds up the recovery by enabling households to rebuild wealth through higher returns on savings. However, low-wealth households are further adversely affected as they have little savings to rebuild wealth from and instead loose due to further declining labor income.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究货币政策如何塑造能源价格冲击的总量和分配效应。基于家庭能源消费暴露和财富的观测异质性，我们构建了一个与欧元区数据显著特征相匹配的定量小型开放经济HANK模型。我们的模型将能源同时作为具有非位似偏好的家庭的消费品以及具有投入互补性的生产中的要素投入。无论政策如何，能源价格冲击总是减少总消费。财富较少的家庭通过劳动收入下降和直接的负面价格效应受到更不利的影响。积极的政策响应，即针对通胀提高利率，通过减少总需求放大了总量结果，但通过使家庭能够通过更高的储蓄回报重建财富来加速复苏。然而，低财富家庭受到进一步的不利影响，因为他们几乎没有储蓄来重建财富，反而因劳动收入进一步下降而受损。

articles.title_en: Public pensions reforms: Financial and political sustainability
articles.title_cn: 公共养老金改革：财政与政治可持续性
articles.abstract_en: One main reason for the unsustainability of future pensions in many European countries is a failure to adapt to very long-term demographic trends. Also, a reform to address financing issues can be an occasion to improve pension design. Sometimes, however, such pension reforms are likely to be overturned when they lead to significant short-term losses in retirement income. We use an overlapping generations economy with incomplete insurance markets to show that, with an appropriate design, sustainable pay-as-you go systems can greatly outperform current outdated pension systems. We show this in a calibrated model of the Spanish economy, since Spain is a fairly extreme case of the aforementioned failures to introduce a dynamic pension design to deal with an ageing population. Moreover, by comparing the effect of its ageing transition under these different pension systems, we also show how a fast transition, from the current to a reformed PAYG system can be Pareto-improving, while minimizing the risk of political reversal.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多欧洲国家未来养老金不可持续的一个主要原因是未能适应长期人口趋势。此外，解决融资问题的改革也可能是改善养老金设计的机会。然而，有时这类养老金改革在导致退休收入出现显著短期损失时，可能会被推翻。我们使用一个具有不完全保险市场的重叠世代经济模型来表明，通过适当的设计，可持续的现收现付制可以大大优于当前过时的养老金制度。我们在西班牙经济的校准模型中展示了这一点，因为西班牙是上述未能引入动态养老金设计以应对人口老龄化问题的相当极端的案例。此外，通过比较这些不同养老金制度下老龄化转型的影响，我们还展示了从当前制度向改革后的现收现付制快速过渡如何能够实现帕累托改进，同时最小化政治逆转的风险。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the optimal design of a liability-sharing arrangement as an infinitely repeated game. We construct a noncooperative model with an active and a passive agent. The active agent can take a costly and unobservable avoidance action to reduce the incidence of a crisis, but a crisis is costly for both agents. When a crisis occurs, each agent decides how much to contribute to mitigating it. For the one-shot game, when the avoidance cost is not too high relative to the expected loss of crisis for the active agent, a no-bailout policy always achieves the first-best outcome, at which the active agent puts in effort to minimize the crisis incidence. However, the first-best is not achievable when the avoidance cost is sufficiently high. We show that, in the latter case with the same stage game, the first-best cannot be implemented as a perfect public equilibrium (PPE) of the infinitely repeated game either. Instead, at any constrained efficient PPE with avoidance, the active agent “shirks” infinitely often, though crises are always mitigated, and is bailed out infinitely often. The reason is that promises of future shirking and bailout incentivize the active player to take the costly crisis-avoidance action in the present. This result runs contrary to the typical moral hazard view that bailouts reduce incentives for agents to avoid crises. Here bailouts enhance ex-ante mitigation efforts rather than diminish them and are necessary to achieve the second-best. We use finite-state automata to approximate the constrained efficient PPE and explore some comparative statics of the repeated game numerically.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了作为无限重复博弈的责任分担安排的最优设计。我们构建了一个包含主动代理人和被动代理人的非合作模型。主动代理人可以采取成本高昂且不可观察的规避行动来降低危机发生的概率，但危机对双方代理人来说都是代价高昂的。当危机发生时，每个代理人决定为缓解危机贡献多少。对于一次性博弈，当规避成本相对于主动代理人的预期危机损失不太高时，不救助政策总能实现最优结果，此时主动代理人付出努力以最小化危机发生率。然而，当规避成本足够高时，最优结果无法实现。我们表明，在后一种情况下，即使采用相同的阶段博弈，最优结果也无法作为无限重复博弈的完美公共均衡（PPE）实施。相反，在任何带有规避行为的约束有效PPE中，主动代理人无限频繁地“偷懒”，尽管危机总是得到缓解，并且无限频繁地获得救助。原因是，未来偷懒和救助的承诺激励主动代理人在当前采取代价高昂的危机规避行动。这一结果与典型的道德风险观点相悖，即救助会降低代理人规避危机的激励。在这里，救助增强了事前缓解努力而非削弱它们，并且是实现次优结果所必需的。我们使用有限状态自动机来近似约束有效的PPE，并数值探索重复博弈的一些比较静态分析。

articles.abstract_en: Natural resource extraction can undermine institutions through its negative impact on corruption and public goods provision, potentially affecting individual trust in local government. We examine this conjecture by combining geo-referenced survey data with spatial data on mine locations across 28 post-communist countries of Central and Eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union. Using information on the development status of mineral reserves, we employ a cross-sectional difference-in-differences approach comparing individuals living near active versus not-yet-active mines. Our findings reveal a robust negative relationship between mining production and trust in local government. Analysis of mechanisms indicates that corruption perceptions and practices primarily drive this relationship. While examining alternative non-institutional channels, we find that environmental concerns may also contribute to government mistrust in specific contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然资源开采可能通过其对腐败和公共物品供给的负面影响而削弱制度，进而可能影响个人对地方政府的信任。我们通过将地理参考调查数据与中欧、东欧及前苏联地区28个后共产主义国家的矿点空间数据相结合来检验这一猜想。利用矿产资源开发状态的信息，我们采用横截面双重差分方法，比较居住在活跃矿场与尚未活跃矿场附近的个体。我们的研究结果显示，矿业生产与地方政府信任之间存在稳健的负相关关系。机制分析表明，腐败感知和实践主要驱动了这一关系。在考察其他非制度性渠道时，我们发现环境问题也可能在特定情境下加剧对政府的不信任。

articles.title_en: Income uncertainty, precautionary wealth, and social insurance
articles.title_cn: 收入不确定性、预防性财富与社会保险
articles.abstract_en: Our estimates suggest that across the income distribution, households in the lowest income quintile face greater income risk and accumulate more precautionary wealth than those in the second-lowest income quintile in both Australian and later United States samples. In the earlier sample from United States, the lowest income quintile similarly experiences higher income risk, but contrary to later patterns, holds lower levels of precautionary wealth. Notably, for this earlier PSID sample period only, we find a negative correlation between wealth and participation in means tested programs. Using a structural life-cycle model, we demonstrate that changing the asset limit in means tested social insurance programs can potentially explain these suggestive differences in precautionary wealth among low-income households.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们的估计表明，在收入分布中，处于最低收入五分位的家庭在澳大利亚和后来的美国样本中面临更高的收入风险，并积累比第二低收入五分位家庭更多的预防性财富。在早期的美国样本中，最低收入五分位同样经历更高的收入风险，但与后来的模式相反，持有较低水平的预防性财富。值得注意的是，仅在这个早期的PSID样本期间，我们发现财富与参与经济状况调查项目之间存在负相关。使用结构性生命周期模型，我们证明改变经济状况调查社会保险项目中的资产限额可能潜在地解释低收入家庭中预防性财富的这些提示性差异。

articles.title_en: A quantitative model of trust as a predictor of social group sizes and its implications for technology
articles.title_cn: 信任作为社会群体规模预测因子的定量模型及其对技术的影响
articles.abstract_en: The human capacity for working together and with tools builds on cognitive abilities that, while not unique to humans, are most developed in humans both in scale and plasticity. Our capacity to engage with collaborators and with technology requires a continuous expenditure of attentive work that we show may be understood in terms of what is heuristically argued as ‘trust’ in socio-economic fields. By adopting a ‘social physics’ of information approach, we are able to bring dimensional analysis to bear on an anthropological-economic issue. The cognitive-economic trade-off between group size and rate of attention to detail is the connection between these. This allows humans to scale cooperative effort across groups, from teams to communities, with a trade-off between group size and attention. We show here that an accurate concept of trust follows a bipartite ‘economy of work’ model, and that this leads to correct predictions about the statistical distribution of group sizes in society. Trust is essentially a cognitive-economic issue that depends on the memory cost of past behaviour and on the frequency of attentive policing of intent. All this leads to the characteristic ‘fractal’ structure for human communities. The balance between attraction to some alpha attractor and dispersion due to conflict fully explains data from all relevant sources. The implications of our method suggest a broad applicability beyond purely social groupings to general resource constrained interactions, e.g. in work, technology, cybernetics, and generalized socio-economic systems of all kinds.
articles.abstract_cn: 人类合作及使用工具的能力建立在认知能力之上，这些能力虽非人类独有，但在规模和可塑性上在人类中最为发达。我们与协作者及技术互动所需的能力要求持续投入专注性工作，我们表明这可以从社会经济领域中被启发式地称为“信任”的角度来理解。通过采用信息“社会物理学”方法，我们能够将量纲分析应用于人类学-经济学问题。群体规模与关注细节速率之间的认知-经济权衡是这两者之间的联系。这使得人类能够在从团队到社区的各群体间扩展合作努力，并在群体规模与关注度之间进行权衡。我们在此表明，信任的准确概念遵循一个二分的“工作经济”模型，并且这导致了对社会中群体规模统计分布的正确预测。信任本质上是一个认知-经济问题，取决于过去行为的记忆成本以及对意图进行警惕性监督的频率。所有这些导致了人类社区特有的“分形”结构。对某种阿尔法吸引子的吸引与冲突导致的分散之间的平衡完全解释了所有相关来源的数据。我们方法的意义表明，其适用性远超纯粹的社会群体，可广泛适用于一般资源受限的互动，例如工作、技术、控制论以及各种广义社会经济系统。

articles.title_en: Appetite for Ignorance: Does eating meat cause information avoidance about its harms?
articles.title_cn: 无知的胃口：食用肉类是否会导致对其危害的信息回避？
articles.abstract_en: Meat consumption is associated with environmental and animal-welfare harms, and many people consume more than is healthy. Past research has shown that conflicted consumers manage their beliefs in a variety of domains. Based on two independent studies, we test whether eating meat affects people’s preferences for information about the environmental, animal-welfare, and health harms of meat, as well as the alleged environmental benefits of animal agriculture. Our findings are mixed. Eating beef causes information avoidance about the environmental effects of cattle, and eating pork causes people to avoid information about the health effects of pork. Other results were not significant. We interpret these mixed results as suggesting that eating meat causes information avoidance, but the effects are nuanced as they are meat-specific and topic-specific. This project combines the independent explorations of two teams regarding the same research question. The joint conclusion reached differs from the initial independent conclusions. Consequently, this paper also serves as a case study about the sensitivity of scientific interpretation to experimental design.
articles.abstract_cn: 肉类消费与环境危害和动物福利危害相关，且许多人消费量超过健康水平。过往研究表明，在多个领域中，内心冲突的消费者会管理自己的信念。基于两项独立研究，我们测试食用肉类是否影响人们对肉类环境、动物福利和健康危害信息，以及畜牧业所谓环境益处的偏好。我们的发现是混合的。食用牛肉导致对牛对环境影响的回避，食用猪肉导致人们回避关于猪肉健康影响的信息。其他结果不显著。我们将这些混合结果解释为，食用肉类导致信息回避，但效应是细微的，因为它们针对特定肉类和特定主题。本项目结合了两个团队对同一研究问题的独立探索。联合得出的结论与最初的独立结论不同。因此，本文也作为关于科学解释对实验设计敏感性的案例研究。

articles.title_en: Leaving the past behind: Effects of clean slate regulation on employment and earnings
articles.title_cn: 告别过去：清洁记录法规对就业和收入的影响
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the labor market implications of New Zealand’s clean slate initiative. The clean slate regulation allows automatic concealment of criminal records of previously convicted individuals who remain free of convictions for at least seven years (rehabilitation period) since their last sentence. We use detailed administrative data on criminal court charges to identify our sample of previously convicted individuals who are expected to have their criminal records automatically concealed upon completing their rehabilitation period. By linking our sample to high-frequency tax records including information on employment and earnings, we apply a difference-in-differences framework as well as models developed for staggered assignment of a treatment to study the causal mechanisms. Our analysis reveals that the clean slate reform did not affect eligible individuals’ employment propensity, but led to a modest but precisely estimated two-percent increase in monthly earnings of employed individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们调查了新西兰清洁记录倡议对劳动力市场的影响。该清洁记录法规允许先前被判有罪且自上次判决以来至少七年（康复期）内未再被定罪的个人自动隐藏其犯罪记录。我们使用详细的刑事法庭指控行政数据来识别我们的样本，即那些预计在完成康复期后犯罪记录将被自动隐藏的先前被判有罪的个体。通过将我们的样本与包括就业和收入信息在内的高频税务记录相链接，我们应用双重差分框架以及为交错处理分配开发的模型来研究因果机制。我们的分析显示，清洁记录改革并未影响符合条件的个体的就业倾向，但导致了受雇个体月收入适度但精确估计的二%增长。

articles.title_en: Herd behavior and the intention to vaccinate against COVID-19
articles.title_cn: 羊群行为与接种COVID-19疫苗的意愿
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of herd behavior, or information cascades, on the willingness to be vaccinated against COVID-19. We use the 2021/2022 wave of the European Social Survey combined with data from the organization Our World in Data and measure the herding behavior as the change in the share of vaccinated people in the population just prior to the individual's decision. Controlling for sociodemographic characteristics, health status, COVID-19 illness history, and pandemic-related features, the results show that the information cascade significantly increases vaccination intentions. This suggests that the decision on whether to vaccinate is affected by the behavior of others. Moreover, we find a U-shaped association between the herd effect and the share of the population that is vaccinated. Finally, the herd effect on the vaccination decisions of young people, and people in poor health, is higher than for others.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了羊群行为（或信息级联）对接种COVID-19疫苗意愿的影响。我们使用欧洲社会调查2021/2022年的数据，并结合Our World in Data组织的数据，将羊群行为衡量为个体决策前人群中已接种疫苗比例的变化。在控制社会人口特征、健康状况、COVID-19患病史以及疫情相关特征后，结果显示信息级联显著提高了疫苗接种意愿。这表明是否接种疫苗的决定受到他人行为的影响。此外，我们发现羊群效应与已接种疫苗人口比例之间存在U型关联。最后，羊群效应对年轻人和健康状况不佳者的疫苗接种决策的影响高于其他人群。

articles.title_en: Reaching for gold! The impact of a positive reputation shock on career choice
articles.title_cn: 追求金牌！正面声誉冲击对职业选择的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the causal influence of a positive reputation shock for a particular occupation on career choice. In the unpredictable event that a person from one's own country wins a (gold) medal in a particular occupation at the World Championship of Vocational Skills (WorldSkills), searches for apprenticeship vacancies increased significantly by around 7 %. Most importantly, the increase in searches for apprenticeship vacancies in the current year has also led to a 2.5 % increase in the number of contracts signed in the winning occupation, and there are indications that these apprenticeships have a better match between employers and employees.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了特定职业的正面声誉冲击对职业选择的因果影响。在不可预测的事件中，如果来自自己国家的人在职业技能世界锦标赛（WorldSkills）的特定职业中赢得（金牌）奖牌，学徒职位空缺的搜索量显著增加了约7。最重要的是，当前年度学徒职位空缺搜索量的增加也导致获胜职业中签订合同的数量增加了2.5，并且有迹象表明这些学徒制在雇主和雇员之间具有更好的匹配。

articles.title_en: The evolution of child-related gender inequality in Germany and the role of family policies, 1960–2018
articles.title_cn: 德国与儿童相关的性别不平等演变及家庭政策的作用，1960-2018年
articles.abstract_en: Using German administrative data from the 1960s onward, this paper (i) examines the long-term evolution of child-related gender inequality in earnings and (ii) assesses the impact of family policies on this inequality. Our first (methodological) contribution is a decomposition approach that separates changes in child-related inequality into three components: the share of mothers, child penalties, and potential earnings of mothers (absent children). Our second contribution is a comprehensive analysis of child-related gender inequality in Germany. We derive three sets of findings. First, child penalties (i.e., the share of potential earnings mothers lose due to children) have increased strongly over the last decades. Mothers who had their first child in the 1960s faced much smaller penalties than those who gave birth in the 2000s. Second, the fraction of overall gender inequality in earnings attributed to children rose from 14% to 64% over our sample period. We show that this trend resulted not only from growing child penalties but also from rising potential earnings of mothers. Intuitively, in later decades, mothers had more income to lose from child-related career breaks. Third, we show that parental leave expansions between 1979 and 1992 amplified child penalties and explain nearly a third of the increase in child-related gender inequality. By contrast, a parental benefit reform in 2007 mitigated further increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用自1960年以来的德国行政数据，本文（i）考察了与儿童相关的收入性别不平等的长期演变，（ii）评估了家庭政策对此不平等的影响。我们的第一个（方法论的）贡献是一种分解方法，将儿童相关不平等的变化分为三个组成部分：母亲的比例、儿童惩罚以及母亲的潜在收入（假设无子女）。我们的第二个贡献是对德国儿童相关性别不平等的全面分析。我们得出三组发现。首先，儿童惩罚（即母亲因子女而损失的潜在收入份额）在过去几十年中大幅增加。在1960年生育第一个孩子的母亲所面临的惩罚远小于在2000年生育的母亲。其次，在我们的样本期内，归因于子女的总体收入性别不平等比例从14%上升到64%。我们表明，这一趋势不仅源于儿童惩罚的增加，还源于母亲潜在收入的上升。直观上，在较晚的几十年中，母亲因与子女相关的职业中断而损失的收入更多。第三，我们表明，1979年至1992年间育儿假的扩展加剧了儿童惩罚，并解释了儿童相关性别不平等增加近三分之一的原因。相比之下，2007年的育儿津贴改革缓解了进一步的增加。

articles.title_en: On the GDP effects of severe physical hazards
articles.title_cn: 严重物理灾害对 GDP 的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use local projection methods with instrumental variables to analyze a panel dataset that links monetary damages and geophysical hazard strength (which serve as our instruments), associated with a wide range of severe weather events. This approach allows us to understand the GDP impact of these events at the country level. The estimated impulse response functions indicate a persistent GDP decline lasting several years after an increase in disaster-related monetary damages. More severe disasters leave a disproportionately larger negative effect on the economy. For the top 10 percent of disasters, GDP remains approximately 2 percent lower in the medium term (5-7 years) and does not fully recover over the 10-year horizon of our analysis. When disaggregating by disaster type, we find similar results across categories, with storms emerging as the primary driver. High-income countries experience significantly smaller effects than middle- and low-income countries. Our findings are robust to alternative impact measures, such as disaster-related deaths, the number of people affected, or a simple disaster occurrence indicator.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用带有工具变量的局部投影方法来分析面板数据集，该数据集将金钱损失和地球物理灾害强度（作为我们的工具）联系起来，与各种恶劣天气事件相关。这种方法使我们能够了解这些事件在国家层面对 GDP 的影响。估计的脉冲响应函数表明，在与灾害相关的货币损失增加之后，GDP 持续下降数年。更严重的灾害会给经济带来更大的负面影响。对于最严重的 10% 灾害，GDP 在中期（5-7 年）仍保持约 2% 较低，并且在我们分析的 10 年范围内不会完全恢复。当按灾害类型进行分类时，我们发现各个类别的结果相似，其中风暴成为主要驱动因素。高收入国家受到的影响明显小于中低收入国家。我们的研究结果对于其他影响衡量标准是可靠的，例如与灾害相关的死亡人数、受影响的人数或简单的灾害发生指标。

articles.title_en: “Try to Balance the Baseline”: A comment on “Parent–teacher meetings and student outcomes: Evidence from a developing country” by Islam (2019)
articles.title_cn: “尝试平衡基线”：伊斯兰教对“家长教师会议和学生成果：来自发展中国家的证据”的评论（2019）
articles.abstract_en: Islam (2019) reports results from a cluster randomized field experiment in Bangladesh that examines the effects of parent–teacher meetings on student test scores in primary schools. The reported findings suggest strong positive effects across multiple subjects. In this report, we demonstrate that the school-level randomization cannot have been conducted as the author claims. Specifically, we show that the nine included Bangladeshi unions all have a share of either 0% or 100% treated or control schools. Additionally, we uncover irregularities in baseline scores, which for the same students and subjects vary systematically across the author’s data files in ways that are unique to either the treatment or control group. We also discovered data on two unreported outcomes and data collected from the year before the study began. Results using these data cast further doubt on the validity of the original study. Moreover, in a survey asking parents to evaluate the parent–teacher meetings, we find that parents in the control schools were more positive about this intervention than those in the treated schools. We also find undisclosed connections to two additional RCTs.
articles.abstract_cn: Islam (2019) 报告了孟加拉国一项整群随机现场实验的结果，该实验研究了家长教师会议对小学学生考试成绩的影响。报告的研究结果表明，对多个受试者都产生了强烈的积极影响。在这份报告中，我们证明学校层面的随机化不可能像作者声称的那样进行。具体来说，我们显示，九个孟加拉国工会都拥有 0% 或 100% 处理或对照学校的份额。此外，我们还发现了基线分数的不规则性，对于相同的学生和受试者，基线分数在作者的数据文件中以治疗组或对照组特有的方式系统地变化。我们还发现了两个未报告的结果的数据以及研究开始前一年收集的数据。使用这些数据的结果进一步质疑了原始研究的有效性。此外，在一项要求家长评估家长会的调查中，我们发现对照学校的家长比接受治疗的学校的家长对这种干预更加积极。我们还发现了与另外两项随机对照试验的未公开的联系。

articles.title_en: Behind the screens: A replication and extension of Coasian bargaining experiments in the digital age
articles.title_cn: 屏幕背后：数字时代科斯讨价还价实验的复制和延伸
articles.abstract_en: This paper replicates Hoffman and Spitzer's seminal Coasian bargaining experiments from the early 1980s and extends them to examine the impact of digital communication. We find that, while the face-to-face replication results mostly align with the original findings, transitioning to a digital environment induces a 23.3 percent decrease in efficient decision-making and over a fourfold increase in self-regarding behavior. These effects are amplified in one-shot bargaining scenarios and when property rights are strengthened and persist as bargainers gain experience. Our findings allude to several implications of digital communication for efficiency and welfare distributions in negotiation settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文复制了霍夫曼和斯皮策早期 1980 的开创性科斯讨价还价实验，并将其扩展以检验数字通信的影响。我们发现，虽然面对面的复制结果大多与原始发现一致，但过渡到数字环境会导致决策效率下降 23.3%，而自利行为增加四倍以上。在一次性讨价还价的情况下，以及当产权随着讨价还价者获得经验而得到加强和持续时，这些影响会被放大。我们的研究结果暗示了数字通信对谈判环境中的效率和福利分配的几个影响。

articles.title_en: Does one size fit all? The country-specific effects of ECB monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 一种尺寸适合所有人吗？欧洲央行货币政策的具体国家效应
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the way that a change in the ECB's monetary policy affects the members of the euro area in terms of the main macroeconomic aggregates – including inflation and output. Our data set consists of sixteen countries and covers the period from 2009 to 2023. We introduce a spatial VAR, which allows us to decouple the direct effects of a policy change from the spillover effects of the change. In contrast to standard spatial models, which use a predetermined spatial matrix, we estimate the spatial matrix endogenously, thus providing increased accuracy. We find generally symmetric reactions in inflation, output and the other main macro aggregates both in terms of the timing and the magnitude of shocks, and in the effects of shocks on the decomposition between direct and indirect (spillover) effects although there are occasional exceptions. We find that the indirect effects (spillover) effects are generally smaller than the direct effects but that in all cases they reinforce the direct effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们调查欧洲央行货币政策的变化如何影响欧元区成员国的主要宏观经济总量（包括通胀和产出）。我们的数据集由 十六 个国家组成，涵盖 2009 到 2023 期间。我们引入了空间 VAR，它使我们能够将政策变化的直接影响与变化的溢出效应分离。与使用预定空间矩阵的标准空间模型相比，我们内生地估计空间矩阵，从而提供更高的准确性。我们发现通货膨胀、产出和其他主要宏观总量的反应在冲击的时间和幅度方面以及冲击对直接和间接（溢出）效应之间分解的影响方面总体上是对称的，尽管偶尔也有例外。我们发现间接效应（溢出）效应通常小于直接效应，但在所有情况下它们都会增强直接效应。
